name: DROWL Header Slides
description: A flexible header slideshow built on a custom block type (Slick-based).
project_description:
Provides a flexible header slideshow based on custom block type and media type "Slide".

 Versions 
 5.x 
 
 Based on 4.x 
 Swiper insted of Slick / Blazy version of 4.x - needs manual updates where Slick / Blazy was used! 
 Requires drowl_media 5.x 
 
 4.x 
 
 Semver version of 3.x - you can upgrade from 3.x without fear! 
 Drupal 9 Support, no Drupal 8 support due to theme differences 
 Requires drowl_media 3.x || 4.x 
 
 3.x 
 
 Deprecated. Upgrade to 4.x from 3.x with Drupal 9! No further development in 3.x 
 Media in core version 
 Upgrade from 1.x CAREFULLY! May break things! NO real upgrade path! 
 Drupal ^8.8 Support 
 Requires drowl_media 8.x-2.x||3.x 
 
 2.x 
 
 Deprecated & discarded. Do not use. 
 Media entity & blocks based version. 
 NO Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support 
 
 1.x 
 
 Deprecated & discarded. Do not use. 
 Media entity & blocks based version. 
 NO Drupal ^8.8 / 9 Support
